complaints.description: Individual complaints matching the filters, newest first, one row per complaint (paged with search_after; max_rows default 10,000).

search_term.desc: full-text search (all fields unless 'field' is set)

field.desc: where search_term looks: all (default) or company (the API answers HTTP 400 to any other value; narratives are no longer published)

product.desc: exact product name, e.g. 'Mortgage', 'Debt collection', 'Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports'; a list = OR

sub_product.desc: exact sub-product name; needs exactly one product (sent as product='<product>' + U+2022 bullet + '<sub_product>', the only form the API applies); a list = OR

issue.desc: exact issue name, e.g. 'Struggling to repay your loan'

sub_issue.desc: exact sub-issue name; needs exactly one issue (sent as issue='<issue>' + U+2022 bullet + '<sub_issue>'); a list = OR

company.desc: exact company name as CFPB writes it, e.g. 'WELLS FARGO & COMPANY' (find it with aggregations agg=company)

state.desc: two-letter state or territory code, e.g. 'TX'; a list = OR

zip_code.desc: 5-digit ZIP (consumer-reported; 3 digits plus XX for small areas)

company_response.desc: 'Closed with explanation', 'Closed with monetary relief', 'Closed with non-monetary relief', 'In progress', 'Untimely response' (older: 'Closed', 'Closed with relief', 'Closed without relief')

company_public_response.desc: company's optional public response text category

submitted_via.desc: Web, Referral, Phone, Postal mail, Fax, Email

aggregations.description: Complaint counts by one field (product, issue, company, state, timely, company_response, submitted_via, company_public_response, tags) for the filters; sub=true gives sub_product / sub_issue rows.

sub.desc: true = one row per sub-bucket (product -> sub_product, issue -> sub_issue)
